description.en: npm package adoption advisor for DeepSeek Harness: audits whether a candidate dependency is the best choice (native alternatives, maintenance health, README migration hints) and renders a dependency tree.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 npm 包引入前审查工具：判断候选依赖是否是最优解（原生替代、维护健康度、README 迁移线索），并生成依赖树。
